claude_proposed_widenings.name: magic_item_mixed_mechanics
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item needs passive grants and a separate activated charge-based ability on the same record, but MagicItemMechanics is currently passive-or-activation only.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "You gain a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls while you wear or hold it." and "While wearing or holding the talisman, you can take a Magic action to expend 1 charge..."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: item_contact_or_possession_trigger
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The talisman deals damage on touch and repeats that damage at end of turn while the creature continues holding or carrying it; PassiveMechanics cannot encode item-owned triggered damage.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "A creature that isn't a Fiend or an Undead that touches the talisman takes 8d6 Necrotic damage and takes the damage again each time it ends its turn holding or carrying the talisman."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: save_gate.target_type_disadvantage
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The activation needs a creature-type-conditional penalty on the target's saving throw, which the current save_gate surface cannot express.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "If the target is a Celestial, it has Disadvantage on the save."

claude_proposed_widenings.name: destroy_target
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The failed-save branch annihilates the target rather than merely damaging, moving, or conditioning it.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: "On a failed save, the target falls into the fissure and is destroyed, leaving no remains."
